provenance.label: HAND-AUTHORED. NOT A RECORDING.
provenance.note: Written by hand from the published KSeF OpenAPI contract. No request was ever sent to api-test.ksef.mf.gov.pl, or to any other host, to produce this file. The field names and types come from the contract; every value is invented.
invented: ksefNumber: seller NIP 1111111112, which fails mod-11 on purpose. This is what a TEST-environment number looks like: the ministry tells integrators to use random NIPs there and performs no NIP checksum, so roughly ten in eleven are like this one. The CRC-8 is correct.
acquisitionDate: on the same UTC day (2026-03-01) as the date embedded in the number
invoiceHash: base64 SHA-256 of an ASCII marker string, not of any invoice XML
